name: application-live-presence-avatars
title: Live Presence Avatars
description: Realtime presence indicator components showing which people are currently viewing or collaborating on a document.
useWhen: Realtime presence indicator components showing which people are currently viewing or collaborating on a document.
avoidWhen: Avoid live presence avatars when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Live Presence Avatars uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
